title: Cloned scope collision probability
statement: Let $X$ be a type, let $S$ be a repeated-query scope on $X$, and let $M$ be a natural number. The cloned-scope collision probability is the probability, for uniformly chosen clone labels in $	ext{Fin}(M)$ at each query position, that the resulting cloned query map is not injective.
caveat: The payload does not include the definition of repeated-query scopes or their cloned query maps.
